doc.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Why he left Sarah Vaughan
summary: He stayed too long, enjoyed the clubs and steady pay, but wanted to be with his new children.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Why did I leave? I stayed too long at the fair. I enjoyed it. It was happening, and I was enjoying it. I liked the clubs. I wasn’t making a whole lot of money, but it was pretty steady. I got – I started having children, and I wanted to hang with my children.
Were you able to still maintain your presence on the scene, even through you’re doing . . .?
Maintain my presence on the scene.
As a member of the avant garde.
To some extent, but not really in the same way for that period. Not really. Because we were playing Birdland, which is on the scene. I just didn’t have to wait long
for my money or nothing. Got my money right there. Got in my car and cut out with the fine little ladies.
